| description = Spawns in places like the Karanas and the Commonlands at '''night'''. Drops are from the WK/SK werewolves unless otherwise noted. WC werewolves are able to drop the pelt.

'''West Commonlands'''

The first spawn happens exactly 8:00 PM in WC @ (-515, -800).  It can only spawn 3 times in one night at 8PM, 11PM, and 3AM.  The respawn timer is 10 minutes. (While it does spawn right at 8PM, it doesn't respawn right at 11PM and 3AM--it respawns 10 mins after you kill it.) Soloable as a 30 Rogue. Drops are not as common as listed. Killed 6 in a row with no drops. Confirmed WC Werewolf drops; {{:Lupine Runed Armband}} and {{:Werewolf Pelt}}.
spawns by -4112.00, +3081.00, +67.88 south karana. stare at wall and spawns every 9-10 mins. confirmed on p99 red by wildzy

'''South Karana'''

After the [https://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=370884 Nov 6th, 2020] patch they seem to spawn at random anywhere there is a spawn point for any mob. They then randomly path around the whole zone.
